(2) Correction repetition: user repeatedly corrects, rejects, or undoes your work (e.g., deleting files you created, reverting changes). (3) Clarification repetition: user repeatedly re-explains, expresses confusion, or shows frustration about your understanding of their intent. (4) State repetition: returning to a previous state multiple times (e.g., same error, same misunderstanding, same blocked situation).
